_note: EXAMPLE ONLY - layer C (leader to follower mapping). Joint-space mapping only: matching joint semantics does not mean the two arms reach the same end-effector pose. The coordinator rebuilds its mapper from this stored document at acquire(), so the profile cannot silently override it.

joints._provenance: example_not_measured - direction and scale confirmed per joint only during the authorized low-speed single-joint stage
joints._wrap_note: wrap stays false here: shoulder_pan is a limited SO-101 servo (range in leader.example.json), so the delta must clamp toward the follower limit in the commanded direction instead of taking a shortest path that would swing the base the other way
wrap=true only for the leader joint that actually crosses +-pi continuously (SO-101 wrist_roll); the delta takes the shortest path, then the follower's mechanical/cable limits still clamp it

gripper.conversion: percent -> pulse -> radians -> jaw width through the four-bar linkage; percent is never reinterpreted as an angle
gripper._provenance: derived_not_measured: link_* and lcd_plus_ecd come from the vendor four-bar constants (GRIPPER_HB 0.014, GRIPPER_BC 0.03, GRIPPER_ED 0.037, GRIPPER_DC 0.022, EDC 159deg, GRIPPER_IH 0.02, GRIPPER_IG 0.005). The vendor formula returns a negative width past about pulse 704, so pulse_max 700 keeps the jaws inside the geometrically valid range instead of pretending a closed gripper.
gripper.span_note: example_not_measured: 5.0 pulses per 1 percent spans pulse 700 (0%) to pulse 200 (100%); re-measure the leader percent range against the real jaw travel before use

follow_law: target = measured follower reference + direction * scale * wrapped(leader - leader_reference), then soft/hard clamp, EMA filter and per-cycle rate limit

clutch.on_release: stop following, clear filter and target memory
clutch.on_reengage: capture a fresh reference; never resume the previous target

reference_pose._note: placeholders - the wizard overwrites both sides from live readings at align() and stores them with the calibration version

model_versions.leader_calibration: record the leader layer version hash here when saving
model_versions.follower_calibration: record the follower layer version hash here when saving
